t: A ready-to-use data logger that saves sensor readings to a microSD card.
steps: Buy the board from SparkFun. Pick the no-IMU version for Qwiic sensors or GPS alone.
Insert a microSD card of 32 GB or less.
Plug in a Qwiic sensor, such as a temperature sensor.
Connect the board to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open a serial terminal app at 115200 baud and press a key to see the menu.
Choose your sensors and logging speed in the menu.
Let it log for a while, then open the CSV file in a spreadsheet.
Update the firmware later with the Artemis Firmware Upload GUI.
meta: Wild Open. From $48.95. A few stores.
